title: Festival
summary: FES'TIVAL, adjective [Latin festivus, from festus, or festum or fasti. See Feast.] Pertaining to a feast; joyous; mirthful; as a festival entertainment. FES'TIVAL, noun The time of feasting; an annive

inlines.v: FES'TIVAL, adjective [Latin festivus, from festus, or festum or fasti. See Feast.] Pertaining to a feast; joyous; mirthful; as a festival entertainment. FES'TIVAL, noun The time of feasting; an anniversary day of joy, civil or religious. The morning trumpets festival proclaimed.
